issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue asking that the FHIR document date be stored in Bundle.timestamp rather than server-maintained Bundle.meta.lastUpdated.
initial_application: Commit 852d3b8839 applied FHIR-20210 by changing source/documents.html from Bundle.meta.lastUpdated to Bundle.timestamp.

reconciliation: No source change was made because source/documents.html already says the mandatory document date is found in Bundle.timestamp, and Bundle StructureDefinition/profile source aligns with that guidance.
